description.en: A council of directors on a product or business question: the chair sets an agenda from the project's files and materials, role-bound seats, each on its own model, speak in turn or when they have something to add (the owner may join at any time, ask for the decision or stop it), a judge or the round order picks who speaks next, and the chair ends with a decision record: a page under docs/decisions and handoffs for the next tasks. The talk is stored in the council tables the Council office reads; a plugin reload resumes it where the feed stopped. Started by lane_pilot_council (action start); works under a Lane Pilot run.
description.ru: Совет директоров по вопросу о продукте или бизнесе: председатель составляет повестку по файлам проекта и материалам, места с ролями, каждое на своей модели, говорят по кругу или когда есть что добавить (владелец может вступить в любой момент, попросить решение или остановить совет), судья или порядок кругов выбирает следующего, а председатель заканчивает записью решения: страница в docs/decisions и поручения на следующие задачи. Разговор хранится в таблицах совета, которые читает офис совета; перезагрузка плагина продолжает совет с места, где остановилась лента. Запускается через lane_pilot_council (action start); работает под запуском Lane Pilot.

not_for: a code change: that goes through lane_pilot_dispatch_writer
anything a person asks for in a chat: the PM starts this with lane_pilot_council (action start)

council_id.note: the session the starter already made; empty: open makes it

question.note: the question the council works to a decision

roles.note: role names of the seats; empty: the default seats

materials.note: project files the seats get as evidence

max_rounds.note: 1 to 6; the room takes at most rounds x seats turns

mode.note: room (seats speak when they have something to add) or rounds (a fixed order)

judge.note: a System One judge picks the speaker and weighs the room; off: the built-in rule

nodes.rule: code: the session and its seats (the owner's models for a seat, else distinct stage selections), the chair (the council row of the role table), the project's place, the evidence pack

proof.reason: the chair's own agenda; the JSON schema of the agenda decides whether it is usable
proof.form: parseAgenda: 1 to 8 agenda items and 1 to 8 criteria

nodes.rule: code: the decision request, then the order of the round or the room (the judge's impulse, else the rule); waits up to 10 minutes for the owner when nobody asks for the floor; ends the talk at the round or turn cap

proof.reason: a seat's opinion; it is saved in the feed as it is, PASS when it has nothing to add
proof.form: the answer is the seat's statement, or exactly PASS after the first round

proof.reason: the chair's own record; the decision schema decides whether it is usable
proof.form: parseDecisionRecord: summary, options, recommendation, dissent, experiments, next tasks

nodes.rule: code: the decision page under docs/decisions, a handoff for each next task, the session closed as done, one notice to the PM chat

input.question: How do we raise repeat purchases in the cabinet?

test.live: from a PM chat call lane_pilot_council (action start) with two roles and maxRounds 1, then lane_pilot_council (action status); the Council office shows the same session
